advisories.title: Design-lock binding details
advisories.detail: Pin application-subject.v46.json files[] rows, not beforeImages[] (different digests for repository-file-inventory.v1.json L1154 vs L1543 and implementation-coverage.v1.json L1052 vs L1523). Verify activation -> manifest -> review -> Codex assent -> completion. Applied state is uncommitted, so no git commit replaces per-file hashes. Record the user's separate implementation authorization in the implementation status record; frozen implementationAuthorized:false remains history.

advisories.title: Registry versus design-lock ownership
advisories.detail: design-lock owns architecture provenance (arch path -> digest); schemas/registry.json owns generation (product path -> digest); schemas/README.md is not a third list. Verifier checks each registry sourceSha256 equals a pinned digest with byte-identical migrated copy. Record schemaId/declaredMajor/profile by explicit reviewed mapping where $id lacks a major (urn:opensip:product-v1:workflows:policy-document) or uses a :v3 form (L727-730).

advisories.title: Rust generator trial hazards
advisories.detail: Patterns use ECMAScript lookahead (?![\s\S]) (common.schema.json L30, L98); Rust regex crate lacks lookaround, so patterns must be enforced correctly or refused, never dropped. allOf/if/then, oneOf, const and x-opensip-order must not degrade to serde_json::Value. Generated-code external dependencies need pure-library review for crates/contracts (ch14 L199).

advisories.title: TypeScript lane isolation details
advisories.detail: Keep whatever settings file pnpm 11.10.0 reads inside each lane root; no root pnpm-workspace.yaml, lockfile or node_modules; exact packageManager pin; negative controls seeding a root workspace file and sibling lane lock/script. Development Node 24.16.0 is not the sealed provider runtime/compiler closure; compilerVersion joins the admitted toolchain closure (L711-716).

advisories.title: Rust workspace hazards
advisories.detail: Explicit edition and rust-version in every shared package (resolver 3 uses rust-version); provider manifest declares its own [workspace] and resolver. Cargo discovers .cargo/config.toml hierarchically from the working directory, so a root config would silently affect provider builds inside the checkout; avoid it or prove the provider lane runs from an isolated copy.

advisories.title: Identity vector oracle and negative coverage
advisories.detail: Record oracle provenance (pinned architecture reference vectors and digests, not outputs of the code under test). Include duplicate keys, exponent/float, -0, malformed UTF-8, non-scalar Unicode, depth 32 with root=1, 4 MiB, escape laws, admitted-order arrays and x-opensip-order refusals (identity-and-evidence L113-139).

advisories.title: Meta command precision
advisories.detail: completion is human-only (coverage L1225-1250); JSON completion takes the registered not-applicable refusal. startup_tests.rs should run with unavailable project/store/provider resources and record process/module traces, preparing DR-G03's evidence method without claiming qualification.

advisories.title: M1-routed gate preparation
advisories.detail: DR-G03/G15/G16/G31 route implementation owners to M1 (coverage L4478, L4790, L4815, L5214). Prepare owners/harness specifications and reuse lane-isolation receipts as G16 skipped-lane proof inputs; qualification remains M6.

advisories.title: Dependency-checker selection and seeded controls
advisories.detail: Add TS aliases (tsconfig paths), generated inputs and scripts to item 6 (L1069); record dependency-cruiser versus compiler-API trial; seed one forbidden edge per kind (normal/build/dev/target/feature, provider-compiler leakage, type-only, dynamic, export, script); unsupported resolution fails rather than counting as no edge.
